overloads.semanticRole: The IMPORT DIF command reads data from document , a Windows or Macintosh DIF document, into the table aTable by creating new records for that table.

constraints: By default this command decodes the document using UTF-8; since DIF documents generally use the IBM437 character set, USE CHARACTER SET may need to be called first to set the correct charset.
Field/variable assignment is positional by front-to-back layering order of objects on the current input form, not by name; the input form must contain no buttons, and subform objects are ignored.
Default field/record delimiters (tab / carriage return) come from the FldDelimit/RecDelimit system variables and can be reassigned before the call.
